messages:
maya (infra): Heads up team — we need to file quota increases for an anticipated burst in us-west-2 for the Q3 feature launch. Forecast attached. Need p4d/g5s capacity + ENI/EIP headroom. Who can own the cloud support request? :eyes:

raj (eng-infra): I can take point. Quick q: soft limit bumps or reserve capacity? Recommend soft first, then short-term reservation if needed.

maya (infra): Soft bumps first. Finance wants on-demand vs reserved cost delta before committing.

carla (finance): Send projected on-demand vs reserved delta and any minimum commitment. I can fast-track approval if numbers look reasonable.

tom (sre): Call out ENI and EIP limits. We previously hit ENI caps in us-west-2 which slowed reprovisioning. Also flag NAT gateway throughput if >8Gbps sustained.

raj (eng-infra): Drafting AWS support case. Proposed details:

```
Service: EC2
Region: us-west-2
Requested limits:
- p4d.24xlarge: 8 -> 40
- g5/ai family instances total: 16 -> 64
- vCPU on-demand bump: +960
- ENIs (regional): 500 -> 2000
- Elastic IPs: 50 -> 300
- NAT gateway throughput support: allow bursts to 12Gbps
Reason: Q3 product launch, 6-week burst window for dedicated GPU pools. Need testing window prior to launch.
```

maya (infra): Add note that phased increases are acceptable, and request a temporary override 2 weeks before launch for smoke tests.

quota-bot: Reminder — attach cost forecast and contact email (cloud account alias) in the support case.

raj (eng-infra): Case opened: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/show/CASE-0001234 — please react :thumbsup: if OK.

anna (platform): Ask for AZ spread guidance in the case. If capacity is confined to one AZ we need fallback strategies. Request preferred AvailabilityZones parameter.

maya (infra): Added "multi-AZ preferred, single-AZ fallback" and asked to be notified of which AZs will be used.

carla (finance): Budget check: if we run 40 p4d on-demand for 6 weeks that's a significant delta. I'll post a small cost table once I get the SKUs.

raj (eng-infra): Included preferred start/end in the case: 2026-08-15 -> 2026-09-30. Also requested phased uplift if full quota not available immediately.

maya (infra): Pinging our account rep for a one-off reservation quote; cc'ing @carla so finance sees pricing.

carla (finance): If reservation yields >20% savings we'll likely go for it. Please capture SKU mapping in the reply.

tom (sre): Operations plan: schedule a dry-run to spin up a fraction of the capacity 72 hours before launch and run hammer tests. Use canary routes to avoid production traffic impact.

raj (eng-infra): Dry-run scheduled: 2026-08-12 10:00 PT. I'll circulate runbook and Terraform diff in #eng-infra beforehand.

maya (infra): Also add a line asking for IP warmup guidance for large EIP allocations; we've seen routing issues when announcing lots of IPs quickly.

anna (platform): Include our security review doc link and KMS ARN so they can whitelist packaging rules for private deployments.

raj (eng-infra): Support case updated with all requests. Will paste AWS reply here when it arrives.

maya (infra): If AWS can't meet uplift in us-west-2, fallback is to split burst across us-west-2 + us-east-1 and use model-shard routing. We'll reconvene if that becomes necessary. :crossed_fingers:
